profile.headline: Technical Lead – Lead Software Engineer | Engineering AI & Cloud-Powered Experiences | Agentic Systems • AI Agents • MCP Servers • Agent Skills • Azure • Automation
profile.summary:
I’m a team-focused Technical Lead and Lead Software Engineer passionate about using AI, cloud technology, and automation to solve complex business problems and create better user experiences.

My work sits at the intersection of AI Engineering and AI Solutions Engineering, taking business challenges from idea and architecture through development, integration, and implementation.

I design and build AI agents, custom MCP servers, agent skills, agentic workflows, APIs, and automation solutions that connect AI with enterprise platforms and data. I’m particularly interested in moving beyond traditional chat-based AI toward agents that can securely interact with enterprise systems, execute workflows, use specialized tools and skills, and deliver richer user experiences.

I also work closely with stakeholders, Product teams, and Engineering teams to identify opportunities for AI and automation, translate business requirements into technical solutions, evaluate technologies and architectures, develop proofs of concept, and turn successful ideas into scalable enterprise solutions.

Microsoft Azure is a key part of my development and architecture work. I leverage Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, App Service, Storage, Key Vault, and Azure AI services to build cloud-native integrations, APIs, and automation. Python is a core part of my development work across AI integrations, backend services, data processing, and automation.

My background across software engineering, business systems analysis, APIs, data, automation, and enterprise platforms allows me to bridge the gap between business and engineering—understanding the problem, designing the architecture, and building the solution.

Core Skills & Technologies

AI: AI Agents • MCP • Agent Skills • Agentic Workflows • AI Integrations • Tool Calling

Engineering & Cloud: Python • Azure • Azure Functions • Logic Apps • APIM • REST APIs • JSON

Data & Automation: SQL • Snowflake • Power Automate • Alteryx • Power BI

Enterprise: Seismic • Widen/Acquia DAM • Workfront • Salesforce

Leadership: Technical Leadership • Solution Architecture • AI Solution Design • POCs • Agile • Cross-Functional Collaboration

positions.title: Technical Lead - Senior Business System Analyst
Senior Business System Analyst
positions.insights: API Testing, Seismic Sales Enablement Cloud and +6 skills

positions.title: Senior Product Analyst
positions.description:
Manage Salesforce platform with a focus on Data Management, Workflow Automations, UX customizations, and System Integrations. Prioritize data integrity, implement security best practices, and optimize organizational efficiencies and consistencies.
Execute Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) on data and craft reports and dashboards through Microsoft Power BI and Microstrategy. Leverage these platforms to provide stakeholders and executives with actionable analytics and insights.
Conduct comprehensive testing on Internal and External APIs to guarantee the preservation of data integrity in System-to-System integrations.
Engage in close collaboration with stakeholders and actively participate in projects alongside software engineers throughout the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
Execute and document User Acceptance Testing while identifying inefficiencies and proposing improvements to enhance productivity and effectiveness.
Lead Agile Scrum ceremonies as a Scrum Master, and collaborate with the Product Owner to prioritize tasks for the product team.
Perform regular system maintenance tasks, monitor performance, provide ongoing support, and investigate and resolve issues promptly for all tools managed.
Develop and maintain training materials, conduct user training sessions, and keep users informed about system updates.
Seismic Sales Enablement Platform Administrator managing marketing content, API integrations, and implementing updates for end users.
positions.insights: Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Microsoft Power BI and +19 skills

positions.title: Senior Analyst, Governance & Controls
positions.description:
Developed automated solutions using Robot Process Automation (RPA) on seven legacy applications to perform IT controls and reduce security risk. This saved approximately 500 employee hours a year.
Managed relationship with External and Internal IT Auditors for SOC1 and ICOFR audits on behalf of the IT department.
Created dashboards using Power BI for Product Owners to track audit requests and identify trends.
Completed / facilitated IT audit requests and provided timely responses. Implemented enterprise-wide IT policies and procedures to ensure an appropriate level of compliance.
Collaborated with IT Associates and Business Partners to remediate audit issues and risks.
Served as an IT Risk and Control advisor in strengthening IT controls.

positions.title: Payroll Analyst
positions.description:
Implemented a new process that uses excel reports for more efficient payroll processing and trained managers and team members on the process.
Part of the elite customer service team that researched and analyzed reports to reconcile discrepancies and variances for proper billing to clients.
Aided billing department in running V Look Ups & Pivot Tables in Excel to finalize files to be sent to IT for invoice and timecard printing to the clients.
Acted as a point of contact for multiple branch administrators, recruiters, and consultants for payroll related questions.
Processed payroll to meet strict daily deadlines for six multi-state branches. Approved consultants’ contracts after ensuring accurate paperwork and tax setup.

positions.title: Payroll Tax Analyst
positions.description:
Completed all withholding taxes for the company. 
Made daily tax payments to states and localities.
Booked 300+ journal entries monthly for the Financial Reporting department. Assisted the payroll teams by providing information on tax setup and addressing tax-related inquiries.
Performed state and local audits to ensure proper tax setup per employee. Performed monthly tax adjustments for employees incorrectly set up in the payroll system.

positions.title: Module Processor
positions.description: •	Followed specific client instructions to accurately open, sort and batch payments to prepare for processing with an encoded amount, audit trail, and endorsement to transmit the data to the clients’ accounts receivable systems
